subject: Post-call: OrbitHealth pricing & invoice estimate
summary: Post-call recap and pricing follow-up for OrbitHealth. Sean sends initial recap and requests confirmation of token volumes and budget. Emily confirms volumes and loops in procurement. Sean provides invoice-style estimate and cost model attachments. Procurement acknowledges and requests PO/next steps.
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: OrbitHealth pricing & next steps

Hi Emily — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and the next steps we discussed on the call: 

- Proposed scope: pilot integration of Redwood inference runtime for OrbitHealth internal triage and summarization flows.
- Estimated monthly token volume (your call): ~120M tokens/month (we discussed 80-150M range). Please confirm if this is the right target.
- Target budget range you mentioned on the call: ~$10k- $25k / month. You asked for a $/1M token target so we can tune the model mix and performance/cost tradeoffs.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) I will send an invoice-style estimate + cost model showing per-model unit economics and a blended $/1M token estimate (attached).
2) If procurement needs it, please share billing contact and PO process (looped in) and any contract redlines.
3) We'll book a technical deep-dive with Marcus (cc) if your engineers want to validate latency and KV cache behavior.

Attachments: OrbitHealth_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx (pricing calculator), orbit_cost_model_breakdown.csv (cost line-item export)

If the token target or budget range changes, tell me and I’ll re-run the calculator.

Thanks — talk soon.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@orbithealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orbithealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:18:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: OrbitHealth pricing & next steps

Thanks Sean — good recap. Confirming the numbers from our side: 
- Pilot expected at ~120M tokens/month, ramp to 250M over 3 months if initial results look good.
- Budget: current internal guidance is $10k- $20k/month for the pilot, leadership could stretch to $30k if unit economics justify it.

Procurement contact is procurement@orbithealth.com for PO/redlines. They also requested SOC 2 + recent pen test report; do you have a link or doc we can share?

For the estimate please include an invoice-style breakdown (monthly total, monthly equivalent per 1M tokens, line items for model variant mix, and any one-time onboarding or license fees). Procurement will need that for budget approval.

Best,
Emily
Emily Chen
Head of Product | OrbitHealth
emily.chen@orbithealth.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:02:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: OrbitHealth pricing & next steps

Emily — thanks for the confirmation and for looping procurement. Attached are the updated artifacts you requested:

- OrbitHealth_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx — invoice-style estimate with monthly totals and $/1M token calculation.
- orbit_cost_model_breakdown.csv — underlying cost assumptions (model variant, runtime cost, amortized infra, egress, support).
- redlines_contract.pdf — initial contract with standard enterprise terms (no redlines from our side yet).

Key highlights from the attached estimate:
- Assumptions: 120,000,000 tokens/month for pilot. Model mix (example): large model 35% (higher quality), mid model 25%, small model 40% (low-cost inference).
- Unit economics (examples):
  - Large model: $220 / 1M tokens
  - Mid model: $150 / 1M tokens
  - Small model: $70 / 1M tokens
- Weighted/blended guide: $145 / 1M tokens (based on the model mix above).
- Estimated monthly cost (pilot): 120 * $145 = $17,400 / month.
- One-time onboarding (optional): $3,500 (includes dedicated onboarding sessions and integration support).

Notes and next steps:
- If procurement needs SOC 2 / pen test artifacts, here is a link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-pricing-files (contains SOC2 Attestation and recent pen test summary).
- If leadership pushes for <$12k/month, we can present a conservative model mix to hit ~ $100 / 1M tokens (more small-model routing, caching and tighter tokenization).
- Marcus can set up a tech session to validate latency and caching assumptions for your workload.

Attachments: OrbitHealth_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), orbit_cost_model_breakdown.csv (text/csv), redlines_contract.pdf (application/pdf)

Let me know any adjustments and I’ll update the estimate and re-send a one-page invoice for procurement/finance.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@orbithealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@orbithealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: OrbitHealth pricing & next steps

Thanks Sean — received the estimate and attachments (OrbitHealth_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx, orbit_cost_model_breakdown.csv, redlines_contract.pdf).

Quick questions from procurement: 
- Can you provide a one-page invoice/quote with a PO-ready line item and our company details?
- Do you have a person of contact for billing (name + email) and a standard PO term (net-30)?
- We will review the contract redlines and SOC2 doc. Please also provide at least one reference for an existing healthcare customer (if possible) for our security review.

Procurement will follow up with a checklist and required legal language. Once we have the PO-ready quote and the billing contact, we can start internal approvals.

Regards,
OrbitHealth Procurement
procurement@orbithealth.com
